title: Centralize capability templates under registry
summary: PR consolidates capability fixtures under registry/capability-templates/ and updates CLI defaults + docs consistently. However, a new contributor still faces 4 plausible template directories with no INDEX disambiguation, the migrated capabilities_dir default has no documented error/help for missing path, and 6 .omc/*.tmp scratch files plus triplicated deep-dive spec docs make the PR disorienting to read and the resulting tree disorienting to navigate.

findings.title: 4 candidate template dirs, no single answer for new contributor
evidence: registry/capability-templates/ (new home for capability records + eval-sets/eval-runs)
docs/templates/ (capability-record-template.yaml, capability-record-template-v2.yaml, capability-eval-set-template.yaml — only TEMPLATES, not instances)
PR adds NO README/INDEX to registry/capability-templates/ and does not update docs/templates/INDEX.md to point at the registry as the publish target
findings.ask: Add registry/capability-templates/README.md (or registry/capability-templates/INDEX.md) saying 'copy docs/templates/capability-record-template-v2.yaml here as <capability-id>.yaml; eval-sets/<id>.yaml and eval-runs/<id>.yaml siblings'. Add a one-line breadcrumb at the top of docs/templates/INDEX.md and templates/capability-record-template.yaml pointing to the registry as the publish target.

findings.title: CLI default flips silently — no debuggable error if registry/capability-templates/ is missing
evidence: crates/oya-dev-cli/src/lib.rs: capabilities_dir default changed from product-control/capabilities to registry/capability-templates with no usage-text deprecation note or migration hint for engineers on old branches

Usage text now says '[--capabilities-dir <registry/capability-templates>]' but PR diff shows no added .context()/.with_context() at the new path's read site to surface 'did you mean to run cleanup A #4? path moved 2026-05-16' on a missing dir
foundry_capability_schema_gates.rs / foundry_eval_gates.rs only had 1-line touches; no human-friendly diagnostic added for the rename
findings.ask: On read of capabilities_dir, if path missing, emit a one-shot error: 'registry/capability-templates/ not found — this path replaced product-control/capabilities/ (PR #15, 2026-05-16). Pass --capabilities-dir <old-path> if rebasing across the rename.' Plus a CHANGELOG/runbook entry.

findings.title: Triplicated spec doc disorients readers
evidence: deep-dive-oyatie-sst-consolidation.md exists at THREE paths after PR: .omc/scratch/, docs/specs/, docs/decisions/specs/
PR edits all three with the same 1-line change — proves they are de facto duplicates
No callout in PR body about which is canonical; new contributor cannot tell which to edit next
findings.ask: Pick canonical location (docs/decisions/specs/), replace the other two with one-line redirect stubs citing the canonical path. Out of scope to delete here, but PR body should declare canonical + open follow-up issue.

findings.title: 6 committed .omc/*.tmp.<uuid> scratch files in PR are confusing
evidence: .omc/.project-memory.json.tmp.02e54f69-… and 5 sibling tmp.<uuid> files modified (2/-2 each)
These look like atomic-write temp artifacts that should never be in a PR; they fight git blame and signal a broken .gitignore
PR body does not explain them
findings.ask: Add .omc/.project-memory.json.tmp.* to .gitignore (or move tmp writes outside repo), and either drop these from PR or document why they are tracked.

findings.title: Runbook clarity — no migration note for downstream branches
evidence: Topology move from product-control/capabilities → registry/capability-templates affects anyone with in-flight branches
PR body 'Verification' lists cargo gate runs but no MIGRATION/CHANGELOG/runbook entry; docs/checklists/pre-push.md was touched but only as a 1-line path swap
evidence/multispectrum/capability-template-registry-cleanup-1778915963.json is added but is reviewer-evidence, not a contributor-facing runbook
findings.ask: Add a 5-line entry to docs/checklists/pre-push.md or a CHANGELOG fragment: 'If your branch references product-control/capabilities/, rebase or sed-replace to registry/capability-templates/ — old path no longer exists.'

positives: Registry rows for each moved artifact in registry/artifact-capabilities-registry.json — control-plane visibility is a clear DX win
CLI usage text and 44 doc/standards files updated consistently in one atomic PR — no half-migrated state
Naming justification block in PR body proves v4 BNF conformance for the new directory + 3 artifact ids
recommendation: Land with follow-up issues for F4-1 (registry INDEX), F4-2 (CLI diagnostic), F4-3 (spec-doc dedupe). F4-4 (.tmp gitignore) should be fixed in this PR or a same-day hotfix.
